# Proverbs 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Channels-of water [is the]-heart-of a-king in-[the]-hand-of YHWH; everywhere He-delights He-turns-it.

**2** Every way-of a-man [is]-straight in-his-[own]-eyes, but-YHWH weighs hearts.

**3** To-do righteousness and-justice is-chosen by-YHWH more-than sacrifice.

**4** Haughtiness-of eyes and-broadness-of heart — [the]-lamp-of [the]-wicked [is] sin.

**5** [The]-plans-of [the]-diligent [lead] only to-abundance, but-everyone [who is]-hasty — only to-lack.

**6** [The]-making-of treasures by-a-tongue-of falsehood [is] a-vapor driven — seekers-of death.

**7** [The]-violence-of [the]-wicked drags-them-away, for they-refuse to-do justice.

**8** Crooked [is the]-way-of a-man guilty, but-[the]-pure — straight [is] his-work.

**9** Better to-dwell upon a-corner-of a-roof, than-a-woman-of contentions and-a-house-of sharing.

**10** [The]-soul-of [the]-wicked desires evil; his-neighbor does-not-find-grace in-his-eyes.

**11** When-[the]-scoffer is-punished [the]-simple becomes-wise, and-when-[the]-wise is-instructed he-receives knowledge.

**12** [The]-Righteous-One considers [the]-house-of [the]-wicked, overthrowing [the]-wicked to-evil.

**13** One-closing his-ear from-[the]-cry-of [the]-poor — also he will-call and-will-not-be-answered.

**14** A-gift in-secret subdues anger, and-a-bribe in-[the]-bosom [subdues] wrath strong.

**15** Joy for-[the]-righteous [is] to-do justice, but-destruction for-workers-of iniquity.

**16** A-man wandering from-[the]-way-of understanding — in-[the]-assembly-of [the]-shades will-rest.

**17** A-man-of lack [is one]-loving pleasure; one-loving wine and-oil will-not-become-rich.

**18** A-ransom for-[the]-righteous [is the]-wicked, and-in-place-of [the]-upright [is the]-treacherous.

**19** Better to-dwell in-a-land-of wilderness, than-a-woman-of contentions and-vexation.

**20** Treasure desirable and-oil [are] in-[the]-dwelling-of [the]-wise, but-a-man foolish swallows-it-up.

**21** One-pursuing righteousness and-lovingkindness finds life, righteousness, and-honor.

**22** A-city-of mighty-ones a-wise-man goes-up [against], and-brings-down [the]-strength-of its-trust.

**23** One-guarding his-mouth and-his-tongue guards from-distresses his-soul.

**24** Proud, arrogant — 'scoffer' [is] his-name — one-acting in-[the]-overflow-of presumption.

**25** [The]-desire-of [the]-sluggard kills-him, for his-hands refuse to-work.

**26** All the-day he-craves [with]-craving, but-[the]-righteous gives and-does-not-withhold.

**27** [The]-sacrifice-of [the]-wicked [is an]-abomination; how-much-more when-in-wickedness he-brings-it.

**28** A-witness-of lies will-perish, but-a-man-who-listens will-speak forever.

**29** A-man wicked hardens his-face, but-[the]-upright — he establishes his-way.

**30** There-is-no wisdom, and-there-is-no understanding, and-there-is-no counsel against YHWH.

**31** [The]-horse is-prepared for-[the]-day-of battle, but-to-YHWH [belongs] the-victory.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **21:1**: Palgei-mayim — 'channels/streams of water.' The king's heart is as easily redirected by YHWH as irrigation channels. Sovereignty over political power.

- **21:3**: Asot tzedaqah u-mishpat nivchar la-YHWH mi-zavach — ethics over ritual. Echoes the prophetic tradition (1 Sam 15:22, Hos 6:6, Mic 6:6-8).

- **21:31**: La-YHWH ha-teshu'ah — 'to YHWH the victory/salvation.' Military preparation is legitimate; ultimate outcome belongs to God.

— EMET
